panel.label: Macro
panel.name: macro panel

check_box.label: Enable aim assist (ALT + O in mouselook)
check_box.name: AllynMacroAimAssistEnabled
check_box.tool_tip: Allows ALT + O to toggle the dynamic aim assist while in mouselook. The aim lock (ALT + I) does not depend on this option.

slider.label: Acquisition sensitivity (%):
slider.name: AllynMacroAimAcquisition
slider.tool_tip: How far from the crosshair an avatar can be for the assist to acquire it, as a percentage of half the vertical field of view. 0% never acquires a target.

slider.label: Assist strength (%):
slider.name: AllynMacroAimStrength
slider.tool_tip: How strongly the assist pulls the aim toward the acquired avatar. 0% applies no pull; 99% is the strongest setting and still lets you move the aim away.

panel.text: ALT + I — lock the aim on the avatar under the crosshair (press again to release).
ALT + O — toggle the dynamic aim assist (requires the option above).

The Macro only works in mouselook while "Hitboxes do avatar" (Advanced > Rendering) is enabled. That option is not saved between sessions and must be turned on again after each start. Range is limited by the draw distance and by RLV camera restrictions.
